title: Prove query and complete-cost obstructions for aligned coupling-idle roots (no new κ)
body:
Actual pure coupling-idle alignment forces an extra query in the declared four-arm extension of #6833. If all k>=3 arms share one complete carrier, a principal displacement matrix gives at least 2+ceil(k/2) net thin queries. Even granting one global hub-idle job, the complete frozen-profile invoice is negative for every 1/310<=C<1, all positive lengths and all full binary child trees.

The new results are the actual-carrier obstruction, exact cyclic-sign principal rank, independent support cuts, a missing fusion residual, and the all-length/all-arm cost ceiling. Credit #4666/#5617 and concurrent #6836 for preceding Gram/displacement mechanisms; novelty is not claimed for the shared identity.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a. Frozen #6833: ad24ad966b857dbfed50d9121624db84b2eccc92. Exact source and concurrent pins are in the package.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-coupling-root-obstructions
```
Expected: PASS_COUPLING_ROOT_OBSTRUCTIONS twice and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: independent derivations and cross-review; normal/-O exact rational and integer-root checks; 2,040 sign words (3-10 arms), 1,837 price pairs (3-24 arms, total<=96), and support-minor checks. These deterministic domains were exhausted, without a seed; the universal conclusions use proofs. Semantic controls for false query budgets, dropped duals, invalid scope, false maxima and source corruption. Committed bytes/modes, export integrity and Git-free replay pass. The full remote tree matches tested contents.

No new κ. Four-arm pair alignment and all-arm common alignment are distinct hypotheses. Pure hub-only transport, full two-hub supports, the frozen native invoice and arbitrary-input scalar endpoint are required. Partial sharing, chain/hub mixing, changed output credit and restricted-input ancillas remain outside scope. The ceiling is below the pending result, not below the selected frontier. All five framework assumptions remain inherited; no full supplier admission is claimed.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds (#6833/#6836), Cinna Davis (#4666), Ali Romman (#5617), thu-nmrc, zxv and the native/caller lineage. Apache-2.0.
